judge.rationale: All four primary hypotheses share the GNLY-marked NKG7-high, GZMB-high, KLRD1-high, CST3-low cytotoxic lymphocyte explanation, with only limited divergence in CST3’s proposed role and a few additional contributors such as S100A12, PTPRC, HLA-E, or NKG2 receptors, so more than three-quarters of the molecular content is shared.
